issue.title: Ensure logs are displayed when application fails due to bootstrap config error

body: @geoand how can be this issue reproduced (with older Quarkus version)?

@rsvoboda the easiest way I can think of to reproduce this issue, is to take the integration test: https://github.com/quarkusio/quarkus/tree/1.3.2.Final/integration-tests/spring-cloud-config-client

and change https://github.com/quarkusio/quarkus/blob/1.3.2.Final/integration-tests/spring-cloud-config-client/src/main/resources/__files/a-bootiful-client-prod.json to some invalid JSON.

The native test will fail of course, but with the current code you would see something like

```
 Unable to obtain configuration from Spring Cloud Config Server ...
``` 

in the logs. With the 1.3.2.Final code, the application logs will be completely empty.

body: @geoand I'm wondering why is this problem with invalid json file visible just in native mode. Can you give me some hints?
ah, for surefire run it uses message from application.properties
Exactly, it's just about how this particular test is setup

